args.code:
import pandas as pd

# Compute default rate by arm: defaulted / approved
default_rates = df.groupby('arm').apply(
    lambda x: x['defaulted'].sum() / x['approved'].sum()
).sort_values()

print('Default rates by arm:')
print(default_rates)
print()
print('Lowest default rate:')
lowest_arm = default_rates.idxmin()
lowest_rate = default_rates.min()
print(f'{lowest_arm}, {lowest_rate:.4f}')
